dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたら、始めますね。
dialogue.English: It's time, so let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい！お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: まず初めに　年齢と性別を教えてください
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 39歳女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 39-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい、片付けられなくて困っています
dialogue.English: Well, I'm having trouble keeping things tidy.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 片づけられないと気分もすっきりしませんよね
dialogue.English: When you can’t tidy up, it’s hard to feel clear and refreshed, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 片付けができなのは　お家の中でですか
dialogue.English: Is it at home that you're having difficulty tidying up?

dialogue.content: 言える範囲内で良いので教えて頂けるとうれしいです
dialogue.English: Please share whatever you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: 主婦なので、家の中ですね。働いてないのででも他に居場所があっても同じかもしれません
dialogue.English: I'm a homemaker, so yes, it's at home. I'm not working, but even if I had another place to be, it might be the same.

dialogue.content: 今は家の中の片付けができていないんですね
dialogue.English: So right now, you're finding it difficult to tidy up at home.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 片付けができないのは　いつ頃からでしょうか
dialogue.English: How long have you been having trouble with tidying up?

dialogue.content: 結婚前から苦手でした
dialogue.English: I’ve struggled with it since before I got married.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何か片付けができない理由とかあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you have a sense of why tidying is difficult?

dialogue.content: 片付けようとは思うし片付けるんですけどすぐに散らかるんです
dialogue.English: I do think about tidying up, and I do tidy up, but it gets messy again right away.

dialogue.content: あらら、　すぐに散らかるのですか…
dialogue.English: Oh dear, it gets messy again so quickly...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしてすぐに　散らかってしまうのですか
dialogue.English: What do you think causes it to get messy again so quickly?

dialogue.content: う〜んどうしてかな・・・探し物が見つからなくて探しているうちに更にちらかります
dialogue.English: Hmm, I’m not sure... When I can’t find something and start searching for it, things get even messier.

dialogue.content: お話を聞いていて　片付けができないのではなく探し物をしていくうち　散らかってしまうのではとおもいましたが　いかがですか
dialogue.English: Listening to you, it sounds less like you can’t tidy up and more like things get messy while you’re searching for items. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: 決めつけた思い出ごめんなさいね
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if that sounded presumptuous.

dialogue.content: いえ、散らかっているから物が無くなるんです。だから探しても見つからず
dialogue.English: No, things get lost because it's messy. That's why I can't find them even when I look.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: せっかく　今日はこちらへいらっしゃったのですから一緒に　片付けができるように　考えていきましょうね
dialogue.English: Since you’ve taken the time to come in today, let’s think together about how you can make tidying manageable.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 散らかってる場所はお家全体ですか
dialogue.English: Is the clutter throughout the whole house?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは　一機に整とんするのも大変そうですね
dialogue.English: That sounds like it would be difficult to tidy up all at once.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: 何か　片付けられるような方法とか試されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you tried any methods to help with tidying up?

dialogue.content: あります
dialogue.English: Yes, I have.

dialogue.content: 例えばどんなことでしょう
dialogue.English: For example, what kinds of things?

dialogue.content: 大事な物を置く場所を決めたり業者さんに依頼してみたり
dialogue.English: I've tried deciding on specific places for important items, and I've also tried hiring a professional organizer.

dialogue.content: やってみて　どうでしたか
dialogue.English: How did that go for you?

dialogue.content: 直後は良かったですけどまたすぐに戻ってしまって
dialogue.English: It was good right after, but it went back to being messy again right away.

dialogue.content: もどるんですね　お若いころからの癖になってるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: So it goes back to how it was. I wonder if it's become a habit since you were young.

dialogue.content: そうかも直そうと思ってもできないのでダメですね。私は
dialogue.English: Maybe so. I try to fix it, but I can't, so I feel like I'm hopeless.

dialogue.content: ダメではないですよ。今も片付けをしたくて　こちらへいらっしゃったのでは？
dialogue.English: You're not hopeless. You came here today because you want to tidy up, didn't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お気持ちだけでも充分だと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think just having that desire is more than enough.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あとは　少しづつの整理していくという行動に繋げていかれるとよいとおもうのですが　どうでしょうか
dialogue.English: From there, it might help to translate that into action by organizing little by little. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 少しずつイメージが湧かなくて
dialogue.English: I can’t really picture doing it little by little.

dialogue.content: いきなりは　イメージわきませんよね
dialogue.English: It’s hard to imagine it all at once, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 逆に片付けようと　思うときはどんなときなんですか？
dialogue.English: On the other hand, when do you feel like tidying up?

dialogue.content: 毎日思います思うのに、頭がぐちゃぐちゃして何から手をつけて良いか分からなくて
dialogue.English: I think about it every day, but my mind gets all jumbled and I don't know where to start.

dialogue.content: あ、子供のプリントが無くなって泣かれた時かな
dialogue.English: Oh, maybe when my child's school papers go missing and they cry.

dialogue.content: 片付けたいという　おきもちは　さんあるのですね。子供さんでのやり取りが多いのですね
dialogue.English: So you do have a strong desire to tidy up. It seems like many of these situations involve your child.

dialogue.content: 主人の靴下も片方見つからないとか
dialogue.English: Like when one of my husband’s socks goes missing.

dialogue.content: たくさん原因がありますね
dialogue.English: There are many triggers, aren't there?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 主婦業の大変さお察しします
dialogue.English: I can appreciate how demanding homemaking is.

dialogue.content: でも働いてない主婦なので
dialogue.English: But I’m a homemaker who doesn’t work outside the home.

dialogue.content: そんなことないですよ。主婦業も仕事のうちだと思います私も主婦ですので　わかります
dialogue.English: That's not true at all. I believe being a homemaker is a job in itself. I'm a homemaker too, so I understand.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 家族のものが　結構散らかる原因におもえるのですが
dialogue.English: It seems like your family's belongings are a big part of the reason for the mess.

dialogue.content: まずは　一つ一つ整理するのは　できそうですか
dialogue.English: To start, do you think you could try organizing one thing at a time?

dialogue.content: そうですが、自分の物もうまく片付けられなくて家の中がいつもごちゃごちゃしています
dialogue.English: Yes, but I can't even organize my own things well, so the house is always a jumble.

dialogue.content: 一つ一つとは？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by “one by one”?

dialogue.content: 一機にやろうとすると　大変だとおもうのですね
dialogue.English: I think trying to do it all at once would be overwhelming.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ですから　子供さん　ご主人　自分とわけて　一個だけ片付けていくのはどうでしょう
dialogue.English: So, how about dividing things into categories—your child's, your husband's, and your own—and then tackling just one category?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 少しづつ片付けの癖が自然についてくるかもしれませんよ
dialogue.English: Gradually, you might naturally build a habit of tidying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 主婦業を毎日こなしてる　あなたでしょうから　あせらづ　目の前の一つを整理されてみるのも方法かもしれませんし
dialogue.English: Since you're managing housework every day, maybe just try organizing one thing that's right in front of you without rushing. That could be one approach.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 何よりも　片付けをしたいというおきもちが一番大事だと感じますし　今もお話してますものね
dialogue.English: More than anything, I feel that your desire to tidy up is the most important thing, and we're talking about it right now, aren't we?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫だとわたしは思いますが　できそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I believe you can do it, but does it feel possible to you?

dialogue.content: やってみたいと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'd like to try.

dialogue.content: 無理せづ　できる事から　チャレンジしてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please don’t push yourself—start with what feels doable.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: もし　片付けができたらその時のお気持ちはどんな気分になってるとおもいますか？
dialogue.English: If you were able to tidy up, how do you think you would feel?

dialogue.content: スッキリすると思います
dialogue.English: I think I would feel refreshed.

dialogue.content: スッキリってよいですよね　すっきり　気分爽快になってくれると　うれしいです
dialogue.English: Feeling refreshed is a great feeling, isn't it? I would be happy if you could feel refreshed and clear-headed.

dialogue.content: そうですね。頑張ってみます。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: はい　あなたなら　できそうなかんじがします
dialogue.English: Yes, I have a feeling that you can do it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 他には片付けでのご相談はありませんか
dialogue.English: Is there anything else about tidying up you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 主人と娘と私の物がごちゃごちゃ混ざっているので難しいですが、まずは仕分けからかな　と。
dialogue.English: My husband's, my daughter's, and my things are all mixed up, which makes it difficult, but I guess I could start by sorting them.

dialogue.content: ご自身で整理の方法を思いつくなんて　これからどんどん片付けがはかどりそうで　私も　良くなっていくのが楽しみです
dialogue.English: Coming up with an organizing method on your own is impressive. It seems like your tidying will progress steadily from here, and I'm looking forward to seeing the improvements.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらの方こそ　前向きなお考えでうれしく思います
dialogue.English: Not at all, I'm happy to hear your positive way of thinking.

dialogue.content: これから　片付けの方が得意になると良いですね
dialogue.English: I hope tidying becomes easier for you from now on.

dialogue.content: そうですね。まずはやってみます
dialogue.English: You're right. First, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってくださいね　あなたならきっと片付けができそうです
dialogue.English: Do your best. I'm sure you can do it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間がきましたが　きょうはお話されていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up. How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: 片付けられそうな気がしますありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I feel like I might be able to tidy up. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 私も思います。応援してますね。また　悩みがあるときはいつでも　きてくださいね
dialogue.English: I think so too. I'll be cheering for you. Please feel free to come back anytime you have something on your mind.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは　本日は　ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Well then, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 終了しますね。ありがとうございました。失礼します
dialogue.English: I'll end the session here. Thank you. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （今日はありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today.)
